recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format portrait framed by a thick cream-colored border, featuring a man in a red and black plaid shirt reclining outdoors during twilight. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting one side of the face against a dark, silhouetted landscape background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a square inset frame
High contrast between warm facial highlights and deep shadow background
Text placed exclusively in the outer cream margin
Color coordination between the red plaid and the warm skin tones
coreInvariants: Low-key lighting with a single warm key light source
Extended horizontal typography at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned centrally, shown from the waist up, leaning back to create a diagonal line through the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, illuminated by a warm glow, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold top text, moves down to the illuminated face, follows the diagonal of the body, and rests on the small centered text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space is provided by the thick cream border and the dark, underexposed background within the photo.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Red (plaid shirt) and Warm Gold (skin highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright border and dark photo; high saturation in the red plaid against muted background tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended slab serif and condensed serif
letterConstructionRules: Top text uses extreme horizontal expansion with heavy slab serifs
Bottom text uses a traditional, high-contrast serif with moderate tracking
Top text is dark blue/black; bottom text is dark red/brown

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a small banner graphic

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: ultra-wide slab serif paired with standard-width elegant serif.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal banner with decorative end-caps for bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, horizontally stretched slab serif aesthetic of the top text.
Matches the traditional, high-contrast serif style of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A square photograph of a man with feathered hair in a red plaid shirt reclining in grass at dusk. The background is a dark silhouette of hills. The entire image is centered within a thick cream-colored square frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-extended bold slab serif text in dark blue at the top center of the cream border. Add a small decorative banner at the bottom center of the cream border containing serif text in dark red.

verificationChecks: Is the photo inset a perfect square?
Is the top text significantly wider than it is tall?
Is the border a warm cream rather than pure white?
Is the lighting on the face warm and directional?

adjustableVariables: Specific decorative elements on the bottom banner
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Clear separation between border and photo

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the top text is dark blue/black and the bottom text is dark red.
Check that the subject's shirt is a classic red/black buffalo plaid.
Verify the square aspect ratio of the inner image.
Confirm the cream border is uniform on all four sides.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square inset photo + thick cream border + ultra-extended top slab serif + centered bottom banner serif = Vintage 80s Portrait Style.
